description: Use when the user asks whether a company or person is sanctioned, blocked, debarred or excluded, or wants a KYC/vendor/export check. Checks a company or person against US sanctions (OFAC SDN and other Treasury lists), Commerce BIS Entity/Denied/Unverified lists, State Department ITAR and nonproliferation lists, and the HHS OIG healthcare exclusion list. Returns strong/possible matches with the official source of each, and which lists were checked when. Needs a key for the screening API (get_api_key with its api_id from search_apis "compliance"); $0.10 per check after free checks, or included in a monthly plan.

api_key.description: Optional; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 checks free within 48 hours).
